bio: SimbaSōl is a Montreal-based electronic producer and performer raised in a music-centered household, exposed early to live acoustic instrumentation (djembes, harmonicas, campfire music) that shaped his later electronic direction. His sound blends melodic indie-dance with bass-heavy, moderate-tempo production aimed at sustained late-night dancefloor energy. In 2025 he released across several labels and performed at Piknic Électronik in Montreal.
notable_releases: "Open Arms" with Timo (2025, Shanti Mansion); summer 2025 releases on Kinetika, Melody Lab, and Sanctuary; EP planned on Gardens of Babylon (late 2025)
labels: Shanti Mansion, Kinetika, Melody Lab, Sanctuary, Gardens of Babylon

bio: Yaku Means Water is a Colombian-born, Tulum-based artist with over 20 years of artistic exploration, known for hybrid DJ sets that blend South American roots with cross-cultural, ritual-driven dancefloor rhythms. He is a regular performer in Tulum's electronic scene (Vagalume, Sundaze x TLT, CENOTIKA) and has been billed to perform at Burning Man.
burning_man_history: A mix titled "DHTM Mix Series 097 - Yaku means Water (Live From Burning Man 2025)" was released via Deep House Tulum, indicating a Burning Man 2025 set.

bio: Alkemiss Erika is a San Francisco-based DJ and producer whose musical roots trace back to the 1990s rave scene. She is affiliated with FAM Productions and plays deep house, organic, melodic, progressive, and tribal/Afro house. Outside music she works as a GYROTONIC instructor at The Flowspace Studio.

Bobby Lyte is a San Francisco-based DJ, producer, and software engineer who plays deep house, funk/soul, tech house, and minimal. He hosts the Flow State podcast/radio show, born from combining his software and music interests, and has played SF venues including f8, Wish Lounge, and Natoma Cabana. He is a DJ within the DeMentha Burning Man camp.
burning_man_history: DJ affiliated with the DeMentha Burning Man theme camp; a Spotify playlist titled "Burning Man AKA DeMentha 2025" is credited to him via FlowStateRadio.com.

bio: Yaz is a San Francisco-based DJ playing house and techno, a resident of the DeMentha Burning Man camp, and a founding member of the b2b collective Ronin (known for events like "A Very Ronin Christmas").
notable_collaborations: Founding member of the Ronin b2b collective
burning_man_history: Resident DJ of the DeMentha Burning Man theme camp; recorded set "Live From DeMentha (Wednesday) // Burning Man 2019" and "Yaz b2b Dementha - Wednesday - BM2022" (SoundCloud).

bio: Andrea Castells is a Swedish-Spanish DJ originally from Stockholm, now based in Barcelona, working across Indie Dance, House, Melodic House/Techno, and Progressive House. She co-founded the Barcelona event promoter/community Valhalla Music (and sister company Avalon, which supports emerging local talent), which holds a residency at Pacha Barcelona. She has played Cova Santa (Ibiza), Pacha Barcelona, Input, Lio (Mallorca), Birgit (Berlin), and Vagalume (Tulum).

NEVOS is an Israeli DJ and producer based in Tel Aviv's underground scene, blending house, techno, tech house, and Afro-electronic influences into what's described as "cheeky Latin tech house grooves" with Ibiza after-party energy.

Zach Walker is a DJ/producer originally from California, now based in Costa Rica, who began attending Burning Man at age 16 and has been a core member of Pink Mammoth (San Francisco's Burning Man-rooted art collective and sound camp) since 2008 in roles spanning fundraising lead, resident artist, and community builder. He first played Costa Rica's Envision Festival in 2016 and is active across Costa Rica's electronic scene (Envision, Ocaso, Labyrinto, BPM).
burning_man_history: Long-tenured Pink Mammoth resident artist/DJ (since 2008); recorded sets "Zach Walker - Pink Mammoth - Burning Man 2013" and "Zach Walker - Pink Mammoth - Burning Man 2023" (SoundCloud), plus social posts confirming Pink Mammoth sets at Burning Man 2023 and 2025.

bio: Sasi (Omri Sasi) is an Israeli DJ/producer and co-founder/producer of the Nova music festival who survived the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack on the Nova festival, in which he lost four relatives. In 2024 he co-led "Nova Heaven," a memorial installation at Burning Man honoring the Nova victims.
notable_collaborations: Sarel Botavia (co-lead on Nova Heaven installation); DJ Captain Hook (b2b set)
burning_man_history: Co-led the "Nova Heaven" memorial installation at Burning Man 2024 (405 laser-cut wooden angels bearing victims' names, built by a 14-person team with Sarel Botavia). Performed an extended live set with DJ Captain Hook at the installation on Aug 31, 2024, originally planned for 3 hours but which ran to roughly 7 hours.

bio: Cameron Angeli, nicknamed "The Mustache King," is an LA-born-and-based DJ, producer, and musician. He plays bass in Quivver's (John Graham's) live band, has served as second-in-command at Josh Heath's label Golden State Recordings, co-founded and served as CEO of Music Savages, and holds a residency at Avalon Hollywood.
labels: Golden State Recordings (worked closely with founder Josh Heath); Music Savages (co-founder)
notable_collaborations: Quivver (John Graham) — bassist in his live band

bio: Christian Voldstad grew up in the UK before moving to New York, where his first underground party experience led him into DJing. He is a resident DJ at Bespoke Musik and at Ibiza's Beachouse, and joined the All Day I Dream roster, performing at Space Miami, Cova Santa Ibiza, and All Day I Dream festivals. His sound blends deep low-end frequencies with a melodic, melancholic touch.
notable_releases: "Powelstad" EP with Powel (2024), including tracks "Funnybot," "Lucy S Cargo," and "Wallace Hartley"
labels: Bespoke Musik (co-manages the label with founder Rocky Ramniceanu); All Day I Dream (roster artist)
notable_collaborations: Powel (Powelstad EP); Rocky Ramniceanu (Bespoke Musik label)

bio: David Hohme is a Brooklyn-based DJ/producer with a 15-year career in the underground electronic scene, built primarily on word-of-mouth. He founded and runs the label Where The Heart Is Records (Brooklyn born, Portland based), which recently marked its 100th release. He has played Burning Man nine years in a row, including sets at the Robot Heart Bus, Distrikt, and Bubbles & Bass.
burning_man_history: Per his Insomniac artist bio, has played Burning Man 9 years in a row, including the Robot Heart Bus, Distrikt, and Bubbles & Bass. Also hosted a "Welcome Hohme Radio" podcast episode titled "Bubbles & Bass Sunrise, Burning Man 2022."

bio: Breauxx is a Phoenix-based DJ/producer self-described as an "operator of bouncy, infectious dance vibes and blissful vibrations," working in the tech house space.
